claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament runs April 9–12.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday, April 9.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
Round 1 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on Prime Video from 1–3 p.m. ET.
Round 1 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on ESPN from 3–7:30 p.m. ET.
Round 2 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on Prime Video from 1–3 p.m. ET.
Round 2 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on ESPN from 3–7:30 p.m. ET.

Round 3 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on CBS from 2–7 p.m. ET.
Round 4 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on Paramount+ from 12–2 p.m. ET.
Round 4 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament airs on CBS from 2–7 p.m. ET.
